name: Edilizia Acrobatica
note: Back Partner of Torino FC (club partner page and 2026-27 kit announcements). The shirt brand is 'Acrobatica', the consumer-facing name of the EdiliziAcrobatica group; the club's partner page lists 'Acrobatica - Back Partner'. Chain: EdiliziAcrobatica S.p.A. (listed, Euronext Growth Milan/Paris) -> Arim Holding S.a r.l. (72.62% per the company's shareholders page, updated 10 April 2025). The ultimate holders of Arim Holding S.a r.l. are not established by an open source (la Repubblica, 28 Sept 2026, says CEO Anna Marras controls 72.6% through Arim Holding Sarl, but the article is paywalled).
